Non-Oxford British English standard spelling of paralyze.
To render unable to move; to immobilize.

examples.text: So I stood alone in horror / Paralyzed with fear and dread / When a voice dead and inhuman / Whispered to me "go, you fool, Warren's dead!"

glosses: To render unable to function properly.
